title: Cloncurry Post Office
geometryBasis: The four native corners of the present-day named office control the frontage and site envelope. The circa-1910 photo and Queensland register description establish the projecting central gable and raised twin porches. The original rear wall position is estimated.
sectionBasis: The 1910 photograph shows timber siding, slatted gable, shuttered central window, low timber steps and corrugated hip roof. The front is partly obscured by the carriage and a tear in the archival print. The register confirms the standard T17 layout.
limitations: This represents the original timber office around 1910. The present-day footprint is a broad site control. Historical depth, rear openings, porch lattice details and structural members are approximate.
The photograph is monochrome and partly obscured. Timber, trim and roof colors are estimates. The separate former office used as a residence and later exchange additions are outside this model.
The original public elevation field remains unchanged. Foundation, floor and stair contact are approximate.
